reviewReason: PR review corrected the original bounded-adaptive conclusion: the sampler was manually started, while no production-available non-polling start trigger or deterministic stability stop signal was verified.

maximizedEvidence.notes: Mappings were derived from observed toggles on the pinned runtime.

eventOrProtocolSignals: No socket2 geometry event was observed for pure tiled resize.
tiled resize.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
tiled resize.notes: Passive data could remain stale until an unrelated event. No non-polling signal was verified to start an adaptive burst.

eventOrProtocolSignals: changefloatingmode was observed for the float toggle; no event was observed during the drag/resize itself.
floating drag/resize.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
floating drag/resize.notes: The manually started sampler observed positions, but the movement itself exposed no verified burst-start trigger.

eventOrProtocolSignals: fullscreen and active-window events were observed for state toggles.
maximize/fullscreen.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
maximize/fullscreen.notes: Discrete fullscreen transitions are observable, but this does not cover geometry-only movement.

eventOrProtocolSignals: move-window, workspace, active-special, and focused-monitor events were observed.
workspace/special-workspace.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
workspace/special-workspace.notes: Workspace and special-workspace transitions were observable through events/model updates.

eventOrProtocolSignals: Monitor-related model changes and layer/focus events were observed during the bounded trials.
monitor scale/transform/rearrangement.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
monitor scale/transform/rearrangement.notes: The secondary monitor was restored after each mutation; this row does not provide a trigger for arbitrary client movement.

eventOrProtocolSignals: monitorremoved and workspace relocation events were observed in the usable trial.
hotplug.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
hotplug.notes: One clean restoration trial demonstrated recovery; two trials were contaminated by a monitor re-enable quirk and were excluded.

eventOrProtocolSignals: No event was observed during the ten slow visual-proxy crossings.
slow overlap-boundary movement.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
slow overlap-boundary movement.notes: Crossings used a visual proxy because the FDM-812 rectangle contract was unavailable. The sampler was started manually.

eventOrProtocolSignals: No event was observed during the ten rapid visual-proxy crossings.
rapid overlap-boundary movement.cpuAndLogNotes: The bounded sampler completed 12 samples at 250 ms with roughly 4.2–5.1 ms per query and no observed sustained process or journal churn. Cost was within the provisional budget, but cost alone does not establish a usable trigger.
rapid overlap-boundary movement.notes: A 250 ms sample interval aliased rapid motion, and neither an automatic start trigger nor a stability-based stop signal was verified.

event/protocol.notes: Discrete state/workspace/monitor transitions were observable, but pure geometry movement emitted no usable event.

centralized refresh.notes: A coalesced refresh works only after an event; it cannot self-trigger for event-less geometry changes.

bounded adaptive refresh.notes: The sampler observed geometry only because the experiment started it manually. Without a verified start and stop signal, arbitrary movement requires continuous polling.

documentedLimitations: Geometry-only movement can remain stale until an unrelated event.
Boundary crossings were visual proxies pending the FDM-812 rectangle contract.
documented degraded behavior.notes: No degraded behavior was accepted during this review.

coordinateSpace.description: Hyprland client at/size values were observed in global layout pixels on the pinned two-monitor setup.
coordinateSpace.notes: FDM-812 must provide and validate the shared dock/client rectangle contract before overlap behavior can be implemented.

refreshObservation.notes: The corrected centralized probe showed no overlapping refreshes, but it cannot initiate from event-less geometry changes.

artifactManifest: Raw window, process, journal, and capture artifacts intentionally remain local and are ignored by Git.
